hints: Do not write a path comparison. Plain BFS with parent recording, over adjacency lists that are already sorted, is the entire answer.
Think about the order vertices enter the queue. Within one BFS level, is that order related to the lexicographic order of their paths?

Induction: if level-d vertices enter the queue in lexicographic order of their paths, then expanding them in that order, each with ascending neighbours, makes level d+1 enter in lexicographic order too.
source: Core of NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 4 Practice Question 1
title: Lexicographically smallest shortest paths
